title: RecordingDefs
description: Shared definitions for the session recording schemas, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md). Not a recording file: the other schemas reference these with $ref.

profile.title: RecordingProfile
profile.description: What a recording keeps: lean (no images or depth), standard (lean plus the non-keyframe candidates, blurred, with depth) or dense (standard with more candidates and mesh snapshots, for short sessions).

historyOp.title: HistoryOp
historyOp.description: What happened to an anchor since its last line: added, moved (update) or removed.

deviceVector.title: DeviceVector
deviceVector.description: [x, y, z] in the device frame (Core Motion axes: x to the right of the screen, y towards the top of the device, z out of the screen), as in the bundle's imu.jsonl.

quaternion.title: Quaternion
quaternion.description: An approximately unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], as Core Motion reports it: not renormalised, so a component can round just past 1. validate-recording checks the norm within 1e-3.

jsonText.title: JsonText
jsonText.description: JSON text: a string that parses as one JSON value, holding what JavaScript passed or received, whose shape the module doesn't fix. At most 16,384 characters (Unicode code points, as maxLength counts them); a larger value is replaced by the marker {"omitted":"too_large","bytes":N}. Readers parse it.

recordingPath.title: RecordingPath
recordingPath.description: Path of a recording file relative to rec-<recording_id>/, using / as the separator. Only the files of the recording layout are allowed; recording.json does not list itself.

stageTimings.title: StageTimings
stageTimings.description: Milliseconds each stage took for one frame; a stage that didn't run is left out. gate: the candidate gate; copy: copying the frame's data; sharpness: the pre-blur score; detect: the face, person and screen detectors; blur; encode: the JPEG; depth: the depth and confidence PNGs; write: writing the files.

stagePercentiles.title: StagePercentiles
stagePercentiles.description: For each stage (as in StageTimings) that ran in the last second, its median and 95th percentile in milliseconds.

percentiles.title: StagePercentile
percentiles.description: A stage's median and 95th percentile time in milliseconds.
